annotations.title: Hotels near a Los Angeles place

description: Ranked hotels near a Los Angeles landmark, venue, airport or neighborhood, optionally for one need (parking, free parking, pets, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast, accessible rooms, EV charging, kitchens, an early flight, or walking distance). Each hotel comes with its straight-line distance, walking minutes and driving distance where held, and the sourced facts that answer the need (for example the stated parking price) with source URL and checked date. The list is the published journeyed.org page for that place and need. If no page covers the need there, the result says so and lists the needs that are covered.

limit.description: How many hotels to return (1 to 10, default 5). The result gives the URL of the full list.

need.description: Optional. What the traveler needs, in plain words: parking, free parking, pets, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast, accessible rooms, EV charging, kitchen, early flight, walking distance.

place.description: A Los Angeles area landmark, venue, airport or neighborhood by name, for example "SoFi Stadium", "LAX", "Disneyland", "Santa Monica". list_places gives every place covered.

name: hotels_near

items.description: One hotel of a ranked list, with its journeyed.org page URL.
One sourced fact. sourceUrl (a web page) or dataset (an open dataset id) says where it came from; checkedOn is the date it was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

needsCovered.description: Needs that have a published page at this place.

page.description: The published journeyed.org page the rows come from. Cite url.

total.description: Hotels on the full list at page.url.
